note.subject: economy
note.why_in_news: The Railway Board approved the first Vande Bharat Sleeper Express connecting KSR Bengaluru to Mumbai (CSMT) to enhance high-speed rail connectivity in South India.
note.fact_box: The service operates six days a week using two trainsets. Train 27652 departs KSR Bengaluru at 10:00 p.m., and Train 27651 departs CSMT at 10:30 p.m. This marks the first Vande Bharat Sleeper service for the South Indian region.

prelims_pointers.text: Vande Bharat Sleeper Express: First such service launched for South India connecting Bengaluru and Mumbai.
Railway Board: The apex body responsible for the management of Indian Railways.
Train numbers: 27652 (Bengaluru to Mumbai) and 27651 (Mumbai to Bengaluru).

note.mains_question: Discuss how the expansion of high-speed rail infrastructure like the Vande Bharat Express contributes to regional integration and economic connectivity in India.

mcq.question: With reference to the Vande Bharat Sleeper Express, consider the following statements:
statements: It is the first Vande Bharat Sleeper service launched for the South Indian region.
The service operates only on weekdays.
The service connects KSR Bengaluru to Mumbai (CSMT).
mcq.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is incorrect: The service operates six days a week.

note.subject: governance
note.why_in_news: The Telangana Government announced the release of two pending dearness allowance (DA) instalments worth ₹2,500 crore to state employees.
note.fact_box: The government is releasing two out of five pending DA instalments due since July 1, 2023. A full release would result in a 15.43% salary increase, with the Pay Revision Commission tasked with submitting final recommendations.

prelims_pointers.text: The Telangana Government is releasing ₹2,500 crore in dearness allowance (DA) instalments.
The pending DA instalments have been due since July 1, 2023.
N. Siva Sankar is the head of the Pay Revision Commission in Telangana.

note.subject: geography
note.why_in_news: The IMD reported a significant rainfall deficit in Karnataka, notably a -32% deficit statewide and an extreme -87% shortage in Bengaluru South, attributed to El Niño.
note.fact_box: Karnataka received 564.6 mm of rainfall against a normal of 831.8 mm. Bengaluru city recorded 313 mm (a -236 mm departure), while the HAL station recorded 434 mm.

prelims_pointers.text: Karnataka rainfall deficit: -32% against a normal of 831.8 mm
El Niño: A climate pattern characterized by the warming of surface waters in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean
IMD: India Meteorological Department provides weather forecasting and climate services

note.subject: agriculture
note.why_in_news: The Andhra Pradesh government launched the ₹1 lakh crore 'Global Horticulture Hub - Rayalaseema Rising' project to transform the region into a global horticulture center.
note.fact_box: The project is a three-phase initiative involving a total investment of ₹1 lakh crore, with ₹40,352 crore from government funds and ₹60,000 crore from private investors. It targets an expansion of cultivation to 14.41 lakh hectares across 10 districts to benefit 9.6 lakh farmers.
note.mains_question: Discuss how Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) in large-scale agricultural infrastructure projects can enhance the socio-economic status of small and marginal farmers in India.
